products.name: D-ID
products.note: Talking head AI; photo animation; likeness rights; deepfake risk; Israeli vendor

profile_text.body:
D-ID is an Israeli company that describes itself as a platform for AI-generated video creation. Its core offering centers on building realistic digital humans, or AI avatars, from images or video, with capabilities including voice cloning, multilingual output, and real-time interactive experiences. The company positions its technology as a replacement for traditional video production, arguing it delivers professional-grade results at lower cost.

D-ID's primary product is the Creative Reality™ Studio, a self-service platform that combines the company's deep-learning face animation technology with large language model text generation and text-to-image capabilities. The platform targets both businesses and individual content creators, with stated use cases spanning marketing, employee training, sales presentations, and customer support. D-ID also offers an API for developers building their own avatar-driven applications, and the company lists integrations with Microsoft PowerPoint, Canva, and Google Slides. The company also describes a product called NUI, or Natural User Interface, as an initiative aimed at changing how people interact with digital systems using AI.

The site's held facts categorize D-ID under video generation and editing, and flag considerations around likeness rights and deepfake risk as relevant to its technology. The company has been recognized by G2 for leadership, ease of setup, and performance, according to its own site. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are noted in the available data.
